results.title: Bank Nifty is the index to buy in a flat market
results.plain: In a flat week (Nifty within 3% of 13 weeks ago), Bank Nifty beats the Nifty over the next 4 weeks.

results.title: Bank Nifty beats the Nifty in any market
results.plain: Any week, Bank Nifty beats the Nifty over the next 4 weeks.

results.title: Bank Nifty leads the Nifty
results.plain: After a week where Bank Nifty beat (lagged) the Nifty by 1%+, the Nifty rises (falls) the next week.

results.title: Exchange, broker and AMC stocks win in a slow market
results.plain: In a flat week, an equal basket of BSE, MCX, CDSL, Angel One, CAMS and peers beats the Nifty over the next 4 weeks after 0.25% charges.

results.title: After a sharp weekly fall the Nifty bounces
results.plain: After a week the Nifty falls 3%+, its next 4 weeks are better than usual.

results.title: After a sharp weekly rise the Nifty gives some back
results.plain: After a week the Nifty rises 3%+, its next 4 weeks are worse than usual.

results.title: Last month's worst sector bounces
results.plain: Every 4 weeks buy the sector index that did worst over the last 4 weeks; it beats the Nifty over the next 4.

results.title: The strongest sector keeps winning
results.plain: Every 4 weeks buy the sector that did best over the last 26 weeks; it beats the Nifty over the next 4.

results.title: A sector that lagged for a year catches up ('IT is cheap')
results.plain: A sector that trailed the Nifty by 15%+ over 52 weeks beats it over the next 26 weeks.

results.title: Sector vs Nifty spread snaps back (weekly)
results.plain: When a sector is 2+ standard deviations cheap (rich) against the Nifty over 26 weeks, buy (sell) it and sell (buy) beta x Nifty; exit when the gap closes or after 8 weeks.

results.title: Long Bank Nifty, short Nifty in a slow market (weekly)
results.plain: In a flat week, buy Bank Nifty and sell beta x Nifty for 4 weeks.

results.title: Monthly Nifty iron condor, 2-sigma wings
results.plain: Sold every 4 weeks at the weekly close, priced off India VIX (Black-Scholes, 15% haircut), settled 4 weeks later.

results.title: Narrow Nifty iron condor, wings 100 points
results.plain: Sold every 4 weeks at the weekly close, priced off India VIX (Black-Scholes, 15% haircut), settled 4 weeks later.
